name: identity_persons
description: An IA-MNS Person: the single internal identity that owns conversations, preferences, links, credentials, roles and grants, independent of the surface or method used to sign in.
lifecycle: Persons are never hard-deleted by the application; an owner disables them instead. Shared deployment requires an owner-approved retention policy (PH-09) before rollout.

columns.Meaning: Stable application principal UUID; issued as the access-token principal and conversation owner. Never derived from a provider identifier.
Person-editable display name; initially copied from the first verified provider profile or chosen at enrollment. Not an identity key.
active, disabled or merged. Disabled and merged Persons cannot authenticate and their sessions are revoked.
Person that absorbed this one through a proof-based or owner-approved consolidation; links, local credential, grants and conversations moved there.
Database-clock last profile or status change; informational, not an audit trail.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'merged'::text) = (merged_into IS NOT NULL)) AND ((merged_into IS NULL) OR (merged_into <> id))))
constraints.Purpose: Merged status and target exist together and a Person never merges into itself.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (merged_into) REFERENCES identity_persons(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A merged Person points to an existing Person; never deleted while referenced.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX identity_persons_display_name_idx ON public.identity_persons USING btree (display_name, id)
constraints.Purpose: Bounded administrative listing ordered by name.
